Chapter 9: The Ongoing Journey—Choosing Yourself Again and Again.
You know, there’s this idea out there that transformation is just a single, life-changing decision. Like one big, dramatic moment that flips a switch and suddenly, everything’s different forever.
But real change? It’s a lot messier than that. It’s a bunch of choices, made over and over—sometimes when you’re full of doubt, or when you’re not even sure you’re heading in the right direction.
I want you to imagine a mom who’s spent years putting everyone else first. One day, she decides to finally carve out a little space for her own dreams. Nothing huge—just an hour a week to write, to paint, or simply to enjoy some quiet time. Of course, some weeks, old habits sneak back in and her needs end up at the bottom of the list again. But every time she slips, she chooses to come back to that promise she made herself. It’s slow progress, sure, but with every step, her sense of self grows just a little stronger.
Most of us expect the path to be straight, don’t we? We’re always looking for proof that we’re “doing it right,” that we’re just one step away from real success. But honestly? The journey of choosing yourself never really gets wrapped up in a neat little bow. There are going to be setbacks, detours, and days when you wonder if you’re even making any headway at all.
The real secret is to just keep coming back. Remember why you started, forgive yourself when you slip, and keep putting one foot in front of the other.
Think about a man who worked for years to build his own business. He finally made it—and yet, he found himself feeling restless, uninspired by the same old goals. Instead of settling, he decided to reinvent himself. He learned new skills, picked up new interests, and let himself be a beginner again. It wasn’t easy—starting over rarely is—but the process gave him a whole new sense of purpose.
After a while, it becomes pretty clear that choosing yourself isn’t some finish line. It’s a practice.
It’s about listening to what you need, honoring your values, and taking risks, even when you can’t see the outcome. Most people don’t realize this, but the journey? It never really ends. Every single day brings a fresh set of challenges, new opportunities, and new choices to make.
The world’s always going to keep changing. Circumstances will shift, life will throw curveballs. But your commitment to choose yourself—to invest in your growth, trust your own instincts, and show up just as you are—that’s what will always be the foundation of a meaningful, fulfilling life.
